summary: The 'CustomReportRequest' module is designed to facilitate the creation and management of custom reports. This involves setting up report parameters, handling user inputs for various field selections, and managing multiple views for different types of reports.
purpose: To provide users with the functionality to request, configure, and manage custom reports based on various parameters and conditions specific to students, staff, sites, and other categories.

fields.name: txtStartDate
fields.description: Input field for the start date of the report.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Input field for the end date of the report.

fields.name: txtReportTypeComments
fields.description: Input field for comments related to the report type.

fields.name: txtPurpose
fields.description: Input field for the purpose of the report.

fields.name: txtAudience
fields.description: Input field for specifying the audience of the report.

fields.name: txtRequestedDate
fields.description: Input field for the requested date of the report.

fields.name: txtStudentDataFields
fields.description: Input field for specifying student data fields for the report.

fields.name: txtSitesServicesDataFields
fields.description: Input field for specifying sites/services data fields for the report.

fields.name: txtStudentInformation
fields.description: Input field for student information related to the report.

fields.name: txtStudentAuthorization
fields.description: Input field for student authorization related to the report.

actors.name: UserSession
actors.description: Manages user sessions and provides user-specific data and configurations.

actors.name: Staff
actors.description: Handles staff-related data and actions within the report requests.

workflows.name: SetupHeader
steps: Set user name, email, and phone in header.
Set user agency and department information.

workflows.name: SetupReportType
steps: Define report type based on user selection.
Bind data to the report type dropdown list.

workflows.name: SetupPlacementRequests
steps: Configure view based on user's Placement Coordinator role.
Initialize form fields and dropdowns if not postback.

workflows.name: SetupStudents
steps: Populate student-related fields based on parameters.

workflows.name: HandleUploadedFile
steps: Check if a file is posted and has content.
Create a folder and save the uploaded file.
Return file metadata including URL, size, and type.

workflows.name: CheckFilters
steps: Toggle filter checkboxes based on state parameter.
Set visibility and status of release filters.

business_rules: Only system administrators can see all sites and services.
Report submission is enabled only if a valid report type is selected.
Start and end dates must be provided and validated.
At least one data field must be specified for each report.

validations.name: RequiredFieldValidator1
validations.description: Ensures that comments are provided when the report type is 'OTHER'.

validations.name: RequiredFieldValidator2
validations.description: Ensures that a start date is entered.

validations.name: RegularExpressionValidator1
validations.description: Validates the format of the start date.

validations.name: RequiredFieldValidator3
validations.description: Ensures that an end date is entered.

validations.name: RegularExpressionValidator2
validations.description: Validates the format of the end date.

conditions.name: UserIsSysadmin
conditions.description: Checks if the current user has system administrator privileges.

system_behavior: Automatically sets the term dropdown to 'Custom' by default.
Disables certain fields based on user roles and report state.
dependencies: HSPnet.Framework for common functions and page setup.
HSPnet.DataLayer for accessing department, cohort, and site data.

exceptions.name: FileUploadException
exceptions.description: Handles errors related to file uploads during report requests.
